gui.whimsical_ideas.name: Player Name
gui.whimsical_ideas.help:
Plushie Crafting Table Usage:
1. Put a Plushie Voucher in the input slot
2. Enter a player name, or select a local image from the dropdown
3. Click 'Craft' to create the plushie
4. Skin is fetched from the selected source
5. Local images go in config/doll/
6. Craft a finished plushie again to turn it back into a Plushie Voucher
